shortDescription: BPG Group (formerly Bates PanGulf) is an integrated marketing, advertising, and communications agency headquartered in Dubai.
whatTheyDo: BPG Group provides brand strategy, creative advertising, public relations, media planning, and customer experience (CX) services. In the UAE, it manages omnichannel communications and marketing transformation campaigns for regional corporate, retail, and government clients.
address: Publishing Pavilion, Unit 118, 1st Floor, Me'aisem First, Dubai Production City, Dubai, UAE

shortDescription: Canopy by Hilton Dubai Al Seef is an upscale boutique lifestyle hotel operated by Hilton along the Dubai Creek waterfront.
whatTheyDo: The hotel provides 200 rooms and suites, dining venues including Skafos Mediterranean restaurant, event spaces, rooftop pool amenities, and wellness facilities. In Dubai, it operates hospitality, culinary, front office, housekeeping, and guest services teams serving international tourists and business visitors.
address: Al Seef Street, Umm Hurair 1, Dubai Creek, Dubai, UAE

notes: The directory listed the area as Dubai Internet City; however, the only Canopy by Hilton property in Dubai is Canopy by Hilton Dubai Al Seef in Umm Hurair 1 on Dubai Creek. Hilton's corporate regional office is situated in Dubai Internet City.

whatTheyDo: Capgemini provides IT consulting, cloud infrastructure, enterprise application management, data engineering, and artificial intelligence solutions. In the UAE, it runs delivery and advisory teams across financial transformation, architecture, and technology services for enterprise and public sector clients.

shortDescription: Caterpillar SARL is the regional branch of Caterpillar Inc., managing parts distribution, training, and commercial equipment support across the Middle East.
whatTheyDo: Caterpillar SARL manages regional distribution and product support for construction and mining machinery, diesel and natural gas engines, and industrial turbines.
